provider_free_tests: Tests establish internal design consistency and fail-closed necessary conditions, not implemented runtime enforcement or semantic accuracy.

prerequisite_definitions.exact_source_identity: Snapshot and source ID/offsets are exact and bound to immutable review evidence.
prerequisite_definitions.roles_and_conditions_unchanged: Exact role and condition text are neither expanded nor filled from context.
prerequisite_definitions.required_context_complete: Source reporting identity and required continuation are supplied with explicit unresolved deferral on ambiguity or bound overflow.
prerequisite_definitions.review_witness_bound: An explicitly accepted independent source review is bound to source/roles/state/questions/model/raw receipt/review version; an example boolean is not such a witness.
prerequisite_definitions.raw_fields_compatible: Actual gated voice/recipient/stance decisions agree with supported witness facts; missing/unclear/conflicting required fields cannot be supplied by a reviewer.
prerequisite_definitions.raw_boundary_sufficient: Actual closed boundary decision is local_sufficient; context cannot rewrite that field.
prerequisite_definitions.raw_linked: Actual unchanged probability gate yields linked.
prerequisite_definitions.reviewed_biblical_anchor: Independent review supports the exact left role as biblical text/paraphrase, not merely biblical topic or a nearby citation.
prerequisite_definitions.reviewed_explanatory_edge: Independent review supports the exact directed explanatory move, not citation, reading, repetition or context-only explanation.
prerequisite_definitions.source_voice_supported: Actual gated source voice matches independently supported source identity/time/scope.
prerequisite_definitions.adoption_supported: G2 Bible-edge route requires actual own_or_adopted plus independent support; G3 local route permits actual not_adopted_report for a supported reported act, but never converts it to current credit.
prerequisite_definitions.raw_act_observed: Actual original selected-option gate yields observed for this exact act.
prerequisite_definitions.addressed_utterance_supported: Review supports the exact utterance as addressed human speech rather than narration, prayer to God, or a fragment needing borrowed act content.
prerequisite_definitions.recipient_supported: Actual gated recipient matches independently supported identity and reporting scope.
prerequisite_definitions.phase_identity_preserved: G3 phases have identical utterance identity and each exact expected target, with no reuse/overwrite.
prerequisite_definitions.binding_cannot_add_acts: G3 binding phase has no act fields and cannot introduce or strengthen an act.
prerequisite_definitions.reviewed_present_preacher: Independent review supports the utterance as preacher present-origin address, not a retold past prayer/conversation or quoted/hypothetical speaker.
prerequisite_definitions.reviewed_current_human_recipient: Independent review supports a current human listener as this utterance recipient, not reported person, God or another referenced third party.
prerequisite_definitions.raw_own_or_adopted: Actual gated adoption is own_or_adopted and is independently source-supported.
prerequisite_definitions.circumstance_compatible_if_claimed: No circumstance claim in generic item; if claimed, both original relevance and same-recipient binding must be positive, non-null and independently supported.

route_output_limits.G2_bible_edge: Scoped source-reviewed adopted Bible edge only; no projection permission. Reported non-adopted edges remain diagnostic in this minimal design.
route_output_limits.G3_local_act: Act facts and supported reporting identity only. This route cannot emit current pastor credit or a circumstance-conditioned claim.
route_output_limits.G3_current_preacher_act: Scoped current local act; any circumstance claim additionally requires explicit compatible binding. No score/profile/projection permission.
